hypotheses.H1_full_boundary_recomposition_is_exact: Patching residual sequence, embedding stream, and value bus together reproduces the counterfactual with Fisher fidelity at least 0.999 on both corpora.
hypotheses.H2_residual_sequence_is_major_carrier: The whole Layer-8 residual-sequence patch alone reaches median Fisher fidelity at least 0.50 on both corpora.
hypotheses.H3_current_position_is_not_sufficient: Patching only the final Layer-8 residual position has median fidelity below 0.50 on both corpora.
hypotheses.H4_prior_positions_matter: The whole-residual patch exceeds current-position-only fidelity by at least 0.20 on both corpora.
hypotheses.H5_nonresidual_carriers_matter: Embedding-stream plus value-bus Shapley attribution has median magnitude at least 0.20 on both corpora.
hypotheses.H6_shapley_recomposes_target: The three signed Shapley projection attributions sum to 1 within 1e-5 on every evaluated edit.
